Job Title: Data Engineer
Experience: 3-6 years
Location: Hybrid: Mumbai or Delhi NCR, 3 days a week in the office.

Mandatory Skills:
- Python
- dbt
- Apache Airflow
- Snowflake

Good to have:
- PySpark
- AWS
- Databricks
- BigQuery

Responsibilities:
- Join NovaStream Analytics, a fast-growing analytics engineering firm partnering with consumer and fintech clients to build resilient data platforms and self-serve analytics.
- Design, build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python and dbt to transform raw data into analytics-ready models in Snowflake.
- Develop and orchestrate workflows in Apache Airflow, ensuring reliable scheduling, monitoring and alerting across pipelines.
- Optimize data models and Snowflake performance (clustering, partitioning, resource usage) to meet SLAs for high-volume workloads.
- Implement testing, versioning and CI/CD practices for dbt projects and Python code to ensure reproducibility and low-defect deployments.
- Collaborate with data product managers, analysts and platform engineers to translate business requirements into scalable data solutions and data contracts.
- Troubleshoot production incidents, perform root-cause analysis and implement preventive measures to improve system reliability.
- Participate in design reviews, document pipeline architecture, and mentor junior engineers on best practices in modern data engineering.
- Where applicable, leverage PySpark, AWS, Databricks or BigQuery to extend platform capabilities and improve processing efficiency (preferred skills).
